item.title:
SILENT EDIT: Petition challenging annexation falls short of signature requirement
Published on November 10, 2026
A petition filed in August 2026 challenging an ordinance that annexed land in southeast Cheyenne did not receive enough valid signatures, the City Clerk’s office has announced. As a result, the annexation will remain in place.
Tagged as: , Announcements , Media Releases , Public Notices
